headline: Homeplus starts normalization after 1 year and 6 months; restructuring of 67 stores is inevitable
summary: Homeplus has been freed from bankruptcy risk after its rehabilitation plan won creditor consent and final court approval. It plans to normalise operations centred on 67 stores.
why: Homeplus is a large South Korean discount retailer, and its restructuring affects creditors, store landlords and the domestic retail sector.
